inputs: compiled source or observed MCP catalogue digest
rules: API interpretation uses the existing Topos document, overlay and pin pipeline; no second OpenAPI parser
MCP discovery uses the pinned SDK and a host-permitted transport; discovery is not execution permission
Tool descriptions, schemas, annotations and returned content are untrusted data
A readOnlyHint never grants read access; the existing action and receipt flow must authorize invocation
Namespaces and source identities are unique; missing, duplicate or unknown selections refuse
An observed catalogue digest pins metadata, not future server code or responses
No URL grants network permission; no MCP document may start an executable or forward a credential
The consuming host owns transport policy, credentials, cancellation and lifecycle
This regional adapter does not yet expose a remote or local process transport through connect
The selection is data, not a policy installation or an authority filter on the received source pin
